title: Defender ASR blocks webshell creation on Exchange servers
description: Microsoft Defender Antivirus Attack Surface Reduction rule 'Block Webshell creation for Servers' MUST be enabled in Block mode on Exchange servers. The rule ID is a8f5898e-1dc8-49a9-9878-85004b8a61e6. This built-in rule blocks webshell script creation on servers running Exchange.
subject: Server

references.name: CISA/NSA Microsoft Exchange Server Security Best Practices (October 2025) - enable the Block Webshell creation for Servers ASR rule
Microsoft Defender Attack Surface Reduction rules reference

remediation.description: Deploy the ASR rule in Block mode through the organization's Microsoft Defender or Group Policy management process.

considerations: The rule is provided by Microsoft Defender Antivirus and must be applied consistently to Exchange servers. Test with representative Exchange workloads and review audit events before enforcing Block mode; use centralized policy management where available.
